MakeItOurs Store Preview

Coming soon to Hosted.

This page previews the store with sample projects. Listings, references and the app flow below are not live yet.

Hosted projects that share their designs appear here. Browse a whole project, pick one of its parts (a swing set, a chair, a planter box) and copy its reference. In the MakeItOurs app, paste the reference, choose one of your Hosted projects, and Sawyer asks where and how it should fit before the part is built into your design.

  • Anyone can browse. You don't need the app or an account to look.
  • Adding a part needs Hosted with MPUs in your balance. It runs as a normal Hosted change. Bring Your Own Infra projects can't add store parts.
  • A copy is yours. Once a part is in your project, its code belongs to your project.
  • Sharing decides what's listed. A Hosted project is listed while its design sharing is on; turning sharing off takes it out of the store.

Adding a part in the app Mockup

How a copied reference becomes part of your design. These screens are a mockup of the app flow, which is still being built.

  1. 1

    Paste the reference

    Use a Store Part
    MIO-3f9a1c07d2be-8c41e2a
    Swing setfrom Backyard Play Area
    A-frame leg · Beam · Swing seat · Cedar

    In Projects, choose Use a Store Part and paste what you copied here.

  2. 2

    Choose your project

    Add to which project?
    ● My Back Yard
    ○ Lake Cabin
    Put it near the patio, facing the house.

    Only your Hosted projects, or ones you can edit, are listed. Add a note if you know where it goes.

  3. 3

    Answer Sawyer's placement questions

    Sawyer: Should the swing set sit on the lawn east of the patio, with the swings facing the house?
    Yes, and keep 2 m clear of the fence.
    Sawyer: Got it. Adding the swing set now.
    ✓ Version 5 published

    Sawyer reads the part and your project, asks only what it still needs, then builds it in like any other change.
